preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input consists of lines of text, where the first line is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 100), followed by T test cases. Each test case starts with an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5), followed by a line of N space-separated integers (1 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^9).

preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.splitlines()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 100
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a valid integer T representing the number of test cases, where 1 ≤ T ≤ 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[i*2+1]) for i in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the integer N (length of array) satisfies 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line, N in zip([stdin.splitlines()[i*2+2] for i in range(T)], [int(stdin.splitlines()[i*2+1]) for i in range(T)]))
preconditions.description: Each test case's second line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in line.split()) for line in [stdin.splitlines()[i*2+2] for i in range(T)])
preconditions.description: Each element A_i in the array satisfies 1 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line == '-1' or (len(stdout_line.split()) == N and all(int(x) in A for x in stdout_line.split())) for stdout_line, N, A in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(stdin.splitlines()[i*2+1]) for i in range(T)], [[int(x) for x in stdin.splitlines()[i*2+2].split()] for i in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either '-1' (indicating no valid arrangement exists) or a permutation of the input array of length N.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line != '-1' or not any(is_non_monotonic_subarray_of_length_gt_2(stdout_line.split())), stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the array must be *interesting*, meaning no subarray of length > 2 is non-increasing or non-decreasing. If '-1' is output, the input array cannot be rearranged into an interesting array.
The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

invariants.expression: all(len(stdout_line.split()) == N or stdout_line == '-1' for stdout_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(stdin.splitlines()[i*2+1]) for i in range(T)]))
invariants.description: For each test case, the output line either matches the length of the input array (N) or is '-1'.
